title: Animal off/on display for the season

steps.name: Open off-for-season op
steps.do: Select **Set animal as off display for the season**.
steps.expect: Off display for the season form opens with **Exhibit**, **Species**, **Start date**, **Last day** and **Reason**.

steps.name: Unique species fills exhibit
steps.do: In **Species**, type **African Lion** and select it from the suggestions.
steps.expect: **African Lion** stays selected. **Exhibit** fills with **Africa Savanna**. **Viewing scope** is not shown.

steps.name: Submit with blank reason
steps.do: Leave **Start date**, **Last day** and **Reason** blank. Click **Save**.
steps.expect: Success that **African Lion** in **Africa Savanna** was set as off display for the season.

steps.name: Map without include
steps.do: From the bottom nav, open **Map**. On **Specific Map**, set the date to today. Leave **Include off display animals** unchecked.

steps.name: Winter-blue marker
steps.expect: **African Lion** marker appears with a light winter-blue background. Click it and the message reads **The African Lion is off display for the season.**

steps.name: Regular off display keeps likelihood colour
steps.do: In Console, use **Set animal as off display** for **Cheetah** in **Africa Savanna**, then return to the map with **Include off display animals** enabled.
steps.expect: **Cheetah** uses its usual likelihood colour, not winter blue. Only season off-display animals are winter blue.

steps.name: On-for-season lists season only
steps.do: In Console, open **Set animal as on display for the season**. Leave **Exhibit** empty. In **Species**, type **Cheetah**, then **African Lion**.
steps.expect: **Cheetah** is not suggested because it is not off for the season. **African Lion** is suggested; choosing it fills **Exhibit** with **Africa Savanna**.

steps.name: Submit on for season
steps.expect: Success that **African Lion** in **Africa Savanna** was set as on display for the season.

steps.name: Regular on display cleanup
steps.do: Open **Set animal as on display**. Select **Cheetah** with **Exhibit** **Africa Savanna** and click **Save**.
steps.expect: Success that **Cheetah** in **Africa Savanna** was set as on display.

steps.name: Map restored
steps.do: From the bottom nav, return to **Map** on **Specific Map** today with **Include off display animals** unchecked.
steps.expect: **African Lion** and **Cheetah** show as normal on-display markers again.
